TASK-VERIFY must depend on TASK-IMPLEMENT, and both relationships must cover every required AC, as the original PRD specifies. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct source-manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. The historical-operation isolation facts are consistent with reuse of the attested project without any candidate on this bundle. The original specification's preparation-stage null fields and remaining-work list do not override the subsequently supplied frozen preview. This approval concerns Gold suitability, not execution success, task dispatch, or a human attestation. I used only the supplied review data and did not execute code or independently recompute digests.
